user.title: Charge point
user.description: Pick the sensor that holds the cumulative kWh meter reading of your charge point. For ERE this must be the MID-certified meter built into the charger. Sensors that look like a charger meter are listed first ({candidates} found); tick the box to choose from all energy sensors.
